_comment: Throwaway BIP-340 keypairs for the Nostr key-door spec. FIXTURES, not secrets —
the same posture as `VAULT_AUTH_TOKEN` in stack/compose.yml. Each one was generated
for this file, has never signed anything else, and authenticates nothing but a hub
container that is created and destroyed by `run.sh`. Committing them is what lets the
seeding step (`parachute auth link-pubkey`, which runs before the browser starts) and
the browser's signer agree on a key without a handshake between run.sh and the spec.
Three keys, because the negatives need distinct states that must not interfere:
linked        — bound to the seeded hub user by run.sh; the happy path signs with it
linkedForUnlink — ALSO bound to the same user, so the 'unlinked after login' case can
drop its own link without breaking the happy-path key
neverLinked   — bound to nothing on any hub; the unknown_pubkey case signs with it
